purpose: S card with ON after the model: inside the band (vt=0.5, vh=0.2) the .op starts on, as swload.c:43-60 seeds HYST_ON from SWzero_stateGiven at MODEINITJCT/INITFIX and :69-75 keeps state0 in the band at INITFLOAT. Below and above the band the flag does not matter. With a negative band (neg) or vh=0 and the control at vt (zero), ngspice is on whatever the flag: :76-88 read CKTstate1, which no .op iteration writes (0 = REALLY_OFF), and step it to HYST_ON. SpiceRack P8-045: ESPice dropped the ON word and gave v(omid) = 0.999 V (off); it also started neg and zero off.

oracle.derivation: Stock ngspice-44.2 batch run of this deck, binary raw, columns by name; stock ngspice-45 writes the same bytes for every column. Analytic check: each output is 1 V divided between 1k and the switch, on = 1/1001 V (ron=1) and off = 1meg/1.001meg V (roff=1meg); ngspice is within 1 ulp of both. On and off differ by 1000x, so rtol 1e-9 sees any wrong state.
